content:
Summer sale continues, including AirPods Pro 3 for $50 off, AirPods Max 2 for $100 off, and Apple AirTag 2 at $22 each, while today's 9to5Toys Lunch Break spotlight lands on this 14-inch M5 MacBook Pro with 24GB for $320 off, along with ongoing $500 off the 2TB M5 Pro MacBook Pro, and the cheapest 15-inch M5 MacBook Air with an upgraded power adapter for $170 off. We also have official Apple USB-C cables starting from $7.50 each, Apple's Black iPhone 17 Pro Max TechWoven MagSafe case at a huge 32% off (an Amazon all-time low), and more deals waiting for you.

This 14-inch M5 MacBook Pro with 24GB is $320 off today, with the 2TB M5 Pro version down $500 on Amazon

The best MacBook deals right now are almost a no-brainer — Amazon is selling the 2TB M5 Pro MacBook Pro for a whopping $500 off the new pricing. If you're interested in the M5 MacBook Air, this 24GB config is $200 off, and we also spotted this more affordable Pro version — the 24GB M5 MacBook Pro — saving you $320.

B&H is now selling the cheapest current-generation 24GB MacBook Pro you can get — with 24GB RAM and 1TB storage, down to $1,899 with shipping included.

This machine also comes with an upgraded official 96W Power Adapter, which would normally cost you an extra $20 if you configured this machine on Apple's website.

  • 14-inch M5 MacBook Pro 24GB/1TB $1,899 (originally $2,219)
  • Includes upgraded 96W Apple Power Adapter (worth $20)

Adding it all up, the original price is $2,219, you save $320, and it's the best deal we can find at a reputable retailer. For reference, Amazon is selling the same model with a standard 70W charger for $2,049.

Here's a roundup of this week's best MacBook Pro deals:

  • 14-inch M5 MacBook Pro 16GB/1TB $1,849 (originally $1,999)
  • 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro 24GB/1TB $2,299 (originally $2,499)
  • 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro 24GB/2TB $2,499 (originally $2,999) — $500 off
  • 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro 48GB/1TB $2,699 (originally $3,099)
  • 16-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro 48GB/1TB $3,299 (originally $3,599)
  • 16-inch M5 Max MacBook Pro 48GB/1TB $3,999 (originally $4,399)

M5 Pro MacBook Pro 24GB models $500 off, 48GB models $400 off, plus more deals

Cheapest 15-inch M5 MacBook Air with upgraded Power Adapter down $170 today

We're still tracking $200 off the 24GB M5 MacBook Pro, and this morning we spotted an even more attractive deal on the entry-level 15-inch model — instead of being $150 cheaper, this machine is now $170 off the new pricing.

As we reported in detail yesterday, Amazon is now offering $100 off virtually every M5 MacBook Air configuration they sell:

  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/512GB from $1,199 (currently originally $1,299)
  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/1TB from $1,499 (currently originally $1,599)
  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 24GB/1TB from $1,699 (currently originally $1,799)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/512GB from $1,399 (currently originally $1,499)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/1TB from $1,699 (currently originally $1,799)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 24GB/1TB from $1,899 (currently originally $1,999)

But B&H also has some notable discounts this week, including the 24GB model mentioned above down to $1,499, as well as this $170 off 15-inch M5 MacBook Air entry bundle:

B&H is now selling the 15-inch M5 MacBook Air with 16GB RAM and 512GB storage for $1,349 with shipping included.

  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/512GB $1,349 (originally $1,519)
  • Includes upgraded 70W Apple Power Adapter (worth $20)

This price is already $150 below retail, $50 cheaper than Amazon, but B&H also throws in the upgraded 70W Apple Power Adapter. Configuring the same machine on Apple's website with that charger costs $1,519 — so it's effectively $170 off.

Already discounted official Apple USB-C, Thunderbolt, and MagSafe cables get an extra 10% off, deals starting from $7.50 each

Apple Black iPhone 17 Pro Max TechWoven MagSafe case 32% off (Amazon all-time low)

The latest AirTag 2 still holds at the all-time low "Black Friday in July" pricing, now $22 each

Just like the AirPods deals we covered this morning — AirPods Pro 3 $50 off, AirPods Max 2 $100 off, and AirPods 4 from $99 — today appears to be the last chance to grab Apple's latest AirTag 2 location tracker at an all-time low price.

Amazon has priced the latest 2026 Apple AirTag 4-pack back to the "Black Friday in July" all-time low, and since many official discount events are expected to end tonight, today might be your last chance — Amazon now has a countdown clock on this deal, showing the offer vanishing at midnight.

  • AirTag 2 $27 (originally $29)
  • AirTag 2 (4-pack) $89 (originally $99)

Apple Watch Series 11 summer deals starting to dry up, act fast while the most popular models are still $100 off

We're still tracking $50 off AirPods Pro 3 and $100 off AirPods Max 2 in the summer sale, along with the all-time low on the Apple AirTag 2 4-pack, but deals on the cheapest Apple Watch Series 11 are starting to dry up. If you're looking to upgrade your Apple wearable with $100 off, you'll want to act fast.

Amazon is now selling the 42mm Apple Watch Series 11 for $299 and the 46mm model for $329 with shipping included. That's $100 off the original prices of $399 and $429 for the cheapest models.

However, color options for these deals are starting to dwindle. A few colors are still available at the discounted price, but it seems summer discounts on the Series 11 are starting to go out of stock or return to original pricing from this week onward.

  • 42mm Apple Watch Series 11 $299 (originally $399)
  • 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 $329 (originally $429)

As mentioned above, these $100 discounts come alongside notable ongoing discounts on the latest AirPods, iPhone 17 Pro, and a particularly attractive $500 off the M5 Pro MacBook Pro lineup:

  • AirPods Pro 3 $200 (originally $249)
  • AirPods Max 2 $449 (originally $549)
  • AirPods 4 $99 (originally $129)
  • AirPods 4 (with ANC) $145 (originally $179)
  • AirPods 4 (with ANC) $119 (new originally $179) — Renewed Premium

Amazon's highest-quality refurbished iPhone 17 Pro down $220, 17 Pro Max up to $450 off

If you're looking to grab a current-generation iPhone 17 Pro or Pro Max at a discount, there are some options this week. Opportunities to get brand-new unlocked units from reputable retailers are limited, but we're still tracking up to $220 off the 17 Pro in Amazon's highest-quality refurbished condition, and Woot has once again launched deals of up to $450 off the 17 Pro Max.

On Amazon's side, the 1TB and 512GB iPhone 17 Pro models have resurfaced, up to $220 off — these are Amazon Renewed Premium devices, offering a 1-year Amazon Renewed warranty and "greater than 90% original battery life." Standard Amazon refurbished devices only come with a 90-day warranty and don't offer the same battery guarantee.

  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Cosmic Orange $1,279 (originally $1,599 new)
  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Deep Blue $1,279 (originally $1,499 new)
  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Silver $1,279 (originally $1,499 new)
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Cosmic Orange $1,199 (originally $1,299 new)
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Deep Blue $1,199 (originally $1,299 new)
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Silver $1,199 (originally $1,299 new)

On Woot's side, deals on the larger 17 Pro Max are still ongoing on devices in "pristine" condition, claimed to be "never fallen into customers' hands." Pricing here is up to $450 below Apple's original price, but color options are starting to dwindle:

  • iPhone 17 Pro Max 512GB $1,300 (originally $1,399)
  • iPhone 17 Pro Max 1TB $1,450 (originally $1,599)
  • iPhone 17 Pro Max 2TB $1,550 (originally $1,999)
